name: Puck Dedicated Server
description: Install the Puck dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native Linux server binary directly.
known_limitations: The upstream Egg does not pass its server-name, password, player-limit, or ping-port variables on the process command line; GameNode does not expose ineffective settings.
Stop uses the bounded terminate fallback.

requirements.description: The reviewed Pelican launch targets the native Linux server.
Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.

help.summary: GameNode installs Steam App 3481440 anonymously and launches Puck.x86_64 without a shell.

findings.summary: The reviewed Egg declares settings that are not consumed by its startup command, so they are intentionally not copied.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers
